description: Scan A-share earnings pre-announcements filed in the last N days, newest first then YoY floor desc — the first-hand material for attributing a move to results rather than news flow. Filter by `direction` (positive|negative|uncertain), `report_type`, `min_pct` (YoY floor in percentage points), or `codes` to narrow to a portfolio. `revision` is computed against each name's FULL history, not just rows inside the window, so a downgrade filed today reads as revised_down even when its first version predates the window. Note `min_pct` also drops rows that have no percentage data.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

codes.description: Comma-separated canonical codes (max 200) to filter a portfolio

direction.description: Filter by forecast direction (derived from type, not from the percentage)

min_pct.description: Minimum YoY net-profit change (percentage points); also drops rows lacking percentage data

report_type.description: Restrict to one report period type

name: earnings_recent
